_origin: RECORDED, NOT IMAGINED. Two live 200 responses to GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/usage with headers Authorization: Bearer <pooled access_token> and chatgpt-account-id: <pooled account_id>, read from the codex seat proxy's auth-dir (~/.helm/_global/seats/codex/auth) on 2026-09-14 while task/2480 reproduced the weekly-pacing bug. Every rate-limit field, plan_type, window length, percent, reset and reached-type is byte-exact as the vendor sent it. ONLY the three identity fields (user_id, account_id, email) were replaced with placeholders, and the long-tail marketing blocks (rate_limit_upsell, promo, model_usage, credits, spend_control, rate_limit_reset_credits) were dropped — the reader never looks at them. THE TEAM BODY IS THE BUG: primary (5h) 52% with real headroom while secondary (7d) is at 100% and limit_reached is true, which is exactly the shape helm was pacing on the 5h window and calling healthy. THE PRO BODY IS THE SECOND SHAPE: a single 7d primary with secondary_window null, plus a scoped additional_rate_limits entry that is NOT the account budget.
